In 2398 BFA , [[Vera the great|Vurian]] was named [[Vera the Great]], founding the [[Empire of Areiox Lie]], a complete and total empire controlled from Vurahi. Over time, the new monarch came to be known as the ''Imperium'' (hence [[Areoix Lie Emperor|emperor]]), meaning "commander". During the reign of [[Nurem]], two thirds of the city was ruined after the [[Great Fire of Vurahi]], and the persecution of ________ commenced. [[Vurahi]] would be conquered and [[First Sacking of Vurahi|sacked]] by the [[Kitrum Sei]] in the sixth century BFA But would be conquered back after 68 years. [[Vurahi]] Would fall and be [[Second Sacking of Vurahi|sacked again]] in 480 BFA by the [[Ukardari Empire]]. [[Vurahi]] become Capital of the [[Asturian Empire]] After the [[Ukardari Miltary Revolt]] in 345 BFA. Vurahi Would be Restored to [[Areiox Lie]] and made Capital Again after the [[Arten War of Independence]] led by [[Emperor Thrawn]]. Until its conquest by the [[Ukardari Empire|Ukardari]] the empire was ruled by emperors of the [[Claudian]], [[Flavian]] (who built an [[first Imperial Palace of Vurahi]] ), and [[Hinete]] dynasties
